text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, at a party attended by Satono 
Diamond, Verxina was also invited... or 
rather, she had tagged along.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
Dia-san, that speech earlier was truly 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am deeply honored by your praise.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As a representative of the Satono family, 
it was a crucial occasion to speak about 
our future outlook... I am relieved to 
have fulfilled my duties without issue.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward even more to everyone's 
future prosperity. By the way, the other 
day with Father—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Satono. You're talking to 
such a grown-up person totally normally!
choice_data_list: You're being treated as an equal.
You're being treated as an equal, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Right in the center of such a super-celeb 
party... She looks so, so cool~♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Satono Diamond carried herself 
skillfully among the celebrities and VIPs 
from all circles. As I watched over her—

text_block_list.name: Satono Associate A
text_block_list.text: —Oh my, you are... Vivlos-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Associate A
text_block_list.text:
From the same generation as Dia-san! I've 
heard so much about you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hello there~! I'm so happy you know who I 
am♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That necklace... It's in Arabic... 
right!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Associate A
text_block_list.text: Oh, exactly! Did you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You can place an order and get your 
very own custom jewelry, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If I ever go to Dubai, I want to ask for 
one too~. Aww, it really is super cute♡ 
I'm so jealous~♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it? I'm quite fond of this 
design myself.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it! I mean, it looks suuuper 
gorgeous♡ You must've given the stylist 
great instructions!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I ask a favor, I almost wish 
you'd just come along with me ♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case... the designer is coming 
to Japan soon. Would you like to come 
along?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eh, are you sure!? I wanna go, I wanna 
go~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~♡ Eee, I'm super happy♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a lovely person you are. If you 
are fond of Dubai, I believe there are 
people stationed there attending today as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Really? Please introduce me to them~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy, I'll be right back~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Vivlos vanished into the 
crowd in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Eh, to *that* hotel!? Must be nice~, 
please invite me sometime too♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, she had become the 
center of attention among the party 
guests, chatting away.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks for letting me join today, 
Satono! It was super duper fun~♡”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you were talking with so many 
different people. Everyone looked so 
delighted.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Parties like this tend to lead to 
such formal, stiff conversations..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"It seems everyone's eyes and hearts were 
soothed by your gorgeous charm, 
Vivlos-san. As expected of you!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you think so? Satono is way more 
amazing~!
choice_data_list:
It's great to have peers who respect each 
other.

It's nice to have peers who respect each 
other.
Want to get even closer next time?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you think so? Satono is way more 
amazing~!
choice_data_list:
It's great to have peers who respect each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Satono was cool, and I did great 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: We're such proud classmates, aren't we～♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right! Running in the same 
generation is truly a bond of fate.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best so you can always be 
proud of me, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Then let's do a 'good luck' hug!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kya... Fufu, here you go, take that.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~â¡ Then I'll do even more, hiyah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them shared a warm 
embrace for a short while.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
By matching up to them, do you mean... I 
should act more like a Satono?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sure! I'm super good at mimicking Big Sis, 
so Satono should be a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*ahem* ...Hello, everyone. As I was just 
introduced, I am Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"On this auspicious day, I am deeply 
honored to have the opportunity to speak 
before all of you. Now then—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That was my speech from just now...! Did 
you memorize it after hearing it only 
once?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. From the sound of it~? Can I go just 
a little bit more?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...! Vivlos-san really is... a 
brilliant person.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos had revealed a glimpse of her 
innate genius.
